repositories.description: Source code for Unturned, a free open-world zombie survival sandbox game.
repositories.description_zh: Unturned 的源码仓库。Unturned 是一款免费的开放世界僵尸生存沙盒游戏，适合研究游戏 SDK、模组和玩法系统实现。

repositories.description: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.
repositories.description_zh: 一组来自热门品牌设计系统的 DESIGN.md 分析文件，可放入项目中帮助 coding agents 生成匹配品牌风格的 UI。

repositories.description: A collection of notebooks/recipes showcasing some fun and effective ways of using Claude.
repositories.description_zh: Anthropic 的 Claude cookbooks，收集一批 notebook 和实用配方，展示 Claude 的有趣用法和高效实践。

repositories.description: Fully autonomous AI Agents system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks
repositories.description_zh: 一个全自主 AI Agents 渗透测试系统，可执行复杂安全测试任务，适合研究自动化攻防和安全 agent 编排。

repositories.description: 🚀🤖 Crawl4AI: Open-source LLM Friendly Web Crawler & Scraper. Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/jP8KfhDhyN
repositories.description_zh: 一个面向 LLM 的开源网页爬虫和抓取工具，适合为 AI 应用收集网页内容、构建检索数据和自动化采集流程。

repositories.description: An evolving how-to guide for securing a Linux server.
repositories.description_zh: 一份持续更新的 Linux 服务器安全加固指南，覆盖基础配置、权限、网络和运维安全实践。

repositories.description: Unlimited OCR Works: Welcome the Era of One-shot Long-horizon Parsing.
repositories.description_zh: 百度开源的 Unlimited OCR Works，面向一次性长上下文解析，适合复杂文档和长页面 OCR 场景。

repositories.description: Omnigent is an open-source AI agent framework and meta-harness: orchestrate Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and custom agents — swap harnesses without rewriting, enforce policies and sandboxing, and collaborate in real time from any device.
repositories.description_zh: 一个开源 AI agent 框架和 meta-harness，可编排 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Pi 及自定义 agents，并支持策略约束、sandbox 和实时协作。

repositories.description: DeepSpec: a full-stack codebase for training and evaluating speculative decoding algorithms
repositories.description_zh: DeepSeek 开源的 speculative decoding 训练与评估代码库，用于研究和验证推测解码算法。
